tickets.title: Start retirement plan rollover
tickets.text: Start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) rollover for Nadia Copperwisp after her separation at the end of September 2024, including receiving account registration and the company-stock portion (38% of the $914,000 balance, with 52% diversified equity funds and 10% stable value).
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) move after separation, including receiving account registration and company-stock portion.

tickets.title: Obtain formal pension election packet from plan administrator
tickets.text: Obtain the formal pension election packet for Nadia Copperwisp from the Silver Marmot Laboratories plan administrator so the single-life pension, joint-and-survivor pension for Galen, and delayed Social Security options can be evaluated beyond the portal estimates.
tickets.evidence: By 2024-08-23, the formal pension election packet is needed because only portal estimates were available.

tickets.title: Review first-year retirement income and withholding
tickets.text: Review first-year retirement income and withholding for Nadia Copperwisp, incorporating the final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and first pension timing into the tax projection alongside the $118,000 Teacup Comet Bank savings and roughly $8,400 monthly spending baseline.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-13 to review first-year retirement income and withholding because Tobin noted final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and first pension timing were not yet in the tax projection.
